name: Bang-On Balls: Chronicles - Deluxe Edition
storyline: The story follows a bouncy ball working as an intern at one of the biggest movie production companies in the town of Bobbywood. In this town, the reigning star is Bob Boss, a veteran at the top of the system who has grown into something of a bully, and nobody has yet dared to put him in his place. As Bobbywood shifts around them, the intern travels between various historically inspired worlds to rewrite the events of Bob's most iconic movies. The journey moves through settings such as the Viking era, the Space Race, the Golden Age of Pirates, and Feudal Japan, all in pursuit of becoming the next big star of Bobbywood.
